source_text: Othoniel capit Cariathsepher; Achsa petit fontes superiores et inferiores. Oratio fontes aquae vivae superioris et inferioris scientiae.
pass_a_gloss: Othniel takes Kiriath-sepher; Achsah asks springs upper and lower. Prayer springs of-water living of-higher and of-lower knowledge.
pass_b_english: [[Othniel takes Kiriath-sepher; Achsah asks upper and lower springs >> Bible:Joshua 15:16-19]]. Prayer seeks living springs of higher and lower knowledge.
